At Sunrise.description: Turns the outside lights off in the morning. Run by an automation.

At Sunset.description: Turns the outside lights on at dusk: the patio, the back door, the front of the house and the carport, warm and bright. Run by an automation.

Away from Home.description: For when April is out of the house. Like Goodnight, it turns off everything inside, the fans too, and leaves only the outside lights on.

Bedtime.description: Getting ready for bed: a few dim, warm lights in the bedroom and the hallway, the family room nearly dark, and the bedroom fan on.

Bunnys Room All Off.description: A wall button April no longer uses.

Bunnys Room All On.description: A wall button April no longer uses.

Bunnys Room Bedtime.description: A wall button April no longer uses.

Bunnys Room Top Button.description: A wall button April no longer uses.

Carport Motion.description: Lights the carport and the outside of the house when something moves out there. Run by an automation.

Clean all the Things.description: Every light in the house on bright, for cleaning.

Cooking Time.description: The kitchen lights on bright for cooking.

Family Room Controller Top Button One.description: A wall button April no longer uses.

Family Room Controller Top Button Two.description: A wall button April no longer uses.

Good Morning.description: Nearly every light in the house on, bright and white. It is ugly on purpose, to get April out of bed; she changes it once the coffee is made.

Goodnight.description: Everything off for the night: every light inside, the fans, and the family room heat.

Kitchen Cleanup.description: The kitchen lights low and warm, for cleaning up after a meal. Used late at night for cleaning the kitchen before bed. Makes music play in the kitchen.

Lazy Afternoon.description: A relaxed afternoon: the family room, kitchen, bedroom and office at about two-thirds, mostly warm with some blue.

Low Key.description: Very cozy for at night, set automatically at 9pm on school nights. Most of the house dim and colorful: the kitchen and family room very low, warm with blue, and the bedroom and workshop a little brighter.

Making Time.description: The workshop lit bright for making things.

Movie Time.description: The family room dark for a movie: a few lights at about a sixth, red and warm, and the office and workshop off.

Normal Evening.description: The usual evening across the whole house: warm lights fairly bright in the kitchen, family room and bedroom, the office blue, the workshop blue and green.

Shower Time.description: April's bathroom and bedroom lights on full, for a shower.

Sleepy Time.description: Late at night, dims the outside lights, to be polite to the neighbors and keep bright light out of April's window. It changes nothing inside.

Up Late.description: Staying up late: a handful of dim lights in the family room, bedroom and hallway, with a pink glow on the bird lights.

Work at Home.description: The office set up for a cold, wet Whidbey Island workday, with the kitchen on bright too.
